import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Set aesthetic style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")

# Create figure and adjust dimensions
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))

# Create boxplot with hue for 4K video capability
ax = sns.boxplot(x='sensor_type', y='price_usd', 
                 hue='has_video_4k', data=df, 
                 palette='viridis', dodge=True)

# Customize plot
ax.set_title('Camera Price (USD) by Sensor Type and 4K Video Capability', fontsize=16)
ax.set_xlabel('Sensor Type', fontsize=12)
ax.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=12)
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.legend(title='Has 4K Video', labels=['No', 'Yes'])

# Adjust layout and save
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

```python
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Set aesthetic style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")

# Create figure and adjust dimensions
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))

# Create boxplot with hue for 4K video capability
ax = sns.boxplot(x='sensor_type', y='price_usd', 
                 hue='has_video_4k', data=df, 
                 palette='viridis', dodge=True)

# Customize plot
ax.set_title('Camera Price (USD) by Sensor Type and 4K Video Capability', fontsize=16)
ax.set_xlabel('Sensor Type', fontsize=12)
ax.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=12)
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.legend(title='Has 4K Video', labels=['No', 'Yes'])

# Adjust layout and save
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
